'''Mezase!! Card Master''' (Japanese: '''めざせ！！　カードマスター''' ''Aim to Be a Card Master'') is a one-volume manga series drawn by ''Interu'' (印照) that was published in Japan only in December 2000. The manga features a young boy named [[Kenta Minamii]], who aims to become a champion of the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]].The series focuses on the many Trading Card Game matches he has while on his quest. It is especially notable for taking place in the real world, rather than the [[Pokémon world]] or the [[Trading Card Game Islands]].

==Publications==
The entire series was released as one collected volume.
